steps.title: Lysis of sample
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of sample to a microcentrifuge tube, then add 200 µL Buffer B3 and 25 µL Proteinase K solution. Vortex vigorously, incubate at 70 °C for 10 minutes, and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 210 µL ethanol (96–100 %) to the lysate and vortex vigorously.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column
steps.instruction: Place one NucleoSpin Tissue column into a collection tube, apply the sample‑ethanol mixture to the column, centrifuge for 1 minute at 11,000 × g, discard the collection tube with flow‑through, and transfer the column to a new collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer BW to the column, centrifuge 1 minute at 11,000 × g, discard flow‑through and keep the column in the collection tube. Then add 600 µL Buffer B5, centrifuge 1 minute at 11,000 × g, discard flow‑through and keep the column in the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the column into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL Buffer BE, incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes, centrifuge 1 minute at 11,000 × g. Add the same 100 µL Buffer BE again, incubate 3 minutes at room temperature, centrifuge 1 minute at 11,000 × g, then discard the column.
